text:
vikram: Heads-up — proposing a new "probing + prefetch" hedging policy for when a primary model is approaching saturation. Idea: do a lightweight probe to the primary and, if it's backpressured, route traffic to compatible variants while issuing a prefetch to warm KV/cache for the primary so it can recover faster.

marta: Can you sketch the flow? lightweight probe = what, like a 1-token head request? :thinking_face:

vikram: yeah. Probe = cheap 1-token 'noop' generate with small timeout (50-100ms). If probe succeeds -> send full request to primary. If probe fails or times out -> route to fallback variants immediately. Meanwhile async prefetch tries to warm the primary's KV/cache for that tenant/workload.

jamal: How do we avoid double-billing or double-execution? hedging historically leads to wasted tokens.

vikram: good call. Probe should be charged at fixed tiny cost and accounted separately. Prefetch runs as a low-priority background op that only fetches KV/prefix tokens (not full generation) — cost is bounded. We add `x-hedge-charge: small` in telemetry.

sophia: UX question: how will this surface in the Console? customers will freak if their logs show traffic went to variant-b. Need clarity in traces and rollout controls.

marta: propose console shows a new column 'hedge_status' per route: idle | probing | prefetched | routed-to-variant. Also a sparklines metric: probe_success_rate, hedge_fallback_rate.

vikram: exact config proposal (draft):
```json
{
  "hedge_policy": {
    "enabled": true,
    "probe_timeout_ms": 80,
    "probe_sample_rate": 0.02,
    "prefetch": {
      "enabled": true,
      "max_bytes": 128000,
      "priority": "low"
    },
    "fallback_sequence": ["variant-small","variant-medium","variant-medium-quant"],
    "max_fallback_depth": 2
  }
}
```

jamal: fallback_sequence ordering needs to be tenant-aware. enterprise tenants might prefer higher-quality variants even at higher cost. we have tenant tier and region metadata.

vikram: agreed — we should allow `tier_override`: { "enterprise": ["variant-medium","variant-small"] } and region biases.

sophia: telemetry: we need precise labels so billing + SLOs can distinguish: hedge.probe.latency, hedge.prefetch.success, hedge.fallback.count, hedge.rollback.count. Also add trace_id linking probe->prefetch->request.

ops-bot: deploy-notes: canary plan recommended. start with 1% of traffic across non-enterprise tenants in us-west. monitor `hedge.fallback_rate` and `serving.throughput_primary` for 24h.

marta: question about quotas: if probe triggers fallback, does quota get consumed on the variant pool? We need to surface quota decision and ability to opt-out per-tenant.

jamal: implement: when routing to variant because of probe, check tenant.variant_quota. If insufficient, respect primary queue (possibly queue or 429). Also add tenant opt-in flag `allow_hedge_by_quota`: true/false.

vikram: what about stale model-catalog compatibility? prefetch must only target compatible KV schema. add a compatibility check step based on model-metadata before prefetch.

sophia: console UX for rollouts: add a toggle on rollout screen to enable hedging for a model version and a chart of 'hedge savings vs extra cost' for that rollout window.

jamal: ops concern: prefetch could amplify load spikes if many prefetched at same time. need backoff and jitter and global concurrency cap. maybe use token-bucket per-region prefetch limiter.

vikram: yep — prefetch concurrency cap and exponential backoff with randomized jitter. Also a soft global kill-switch exposed in Console (emergency-disable hedging).

marta: can we add a tiny sampling experiment to measure whether prefetch actually reduces primary recovery time? e.g. A/B: hedging with prefetch vs hedging without prefetch and measure time-to-recover-to-95% throughput.

vikram: good call — add experiment_id to telemetry and expose experiment view.

ops-bot: ack — created infra ticket #INF-4721 for prefetch limiter and #PLAT-8816 for console tiles.

marta: next steps: add API fields for `hedge_policy` to private API proto + SDK, wire telemetry labels, implement probe path in runtime, and add a canary flag in control-plane. I'll draft a Console mock early tomorrow.

vikram: thanks all. I'll post a short design doc later with sequence diagrams and cost estimates. for now i'll enable a 1% canary in us-west non-enterprise tomorrow morning. :rocket:
